DayNightConstants.luau.description: Shared constants describing the day/night cycle. Day is defined as the clock time window between sunrise and sunset; everything else is night.

DayNightUtils.luau.description: Queries and observes whether it is currently day or night, and estimates how long until the next transition. Day/night is derived from `Lighting.ClockTime`: daytime is the window between sunrise and sunset (see [DayNightConstants]), and everything else is night. Time-until estimates are in real seconds and depend on how fast the game clock is advancing.
